description: Where a venue shape's pill or caption sits (normalised plan coordinates). Shared by backend tests/logic/test_venue_shapes.py (shape_anchor) and the frontend's venue-shapes spec (shapeAnchor); both must agree to within 1e-9.

cases.name: polygon: clockwise winding gives the same centroid
polygon: concave L uses the area centroid, not the bbox centre
polygon: degenerate (collinear) falls back to the bbox centre
path: midpoint of a single segment
path: halfway by length lands in the first segment
path: halfway by length lands in the second segment
path: zero length gives its first point
